home.name: Getting started
home.description: Create a project and explore tasks, files, and the workspace
home.title: Welcome to ScholarSeed
home.introduction: Research starts with a project. Materials, literature, task conversations, and outputs stay together, giving AI the context for your work.
home.projectBody: One project for each research direction, with all related files in one place.
home.taskBody: One conversation per question. AI searches, reads, and writes with your project materials.
home.outputBody: Reviews, briefs, and drafts return to project files, with citations you can trace.
home.createDescription: Give your research a name. Its tasks and files will be saved in this project.

project.name: Projects
project.description: Project files, materials, literature, and tasks

switcher.title: This is your project
switcher.body: Search, reading, writing, and AI conversations use the materials and literature in this project. Switch or create projects here.

composer.title: Describe your task in one sentence
composer.body: Describe your research task. Use @ to add project materials or literature, and / to invoke research skills.

files.title: Project files
files.body: Materials, literature, and AI-generated outputs are collected here. Open them in the workspace.

materials.title: Materials
materials.body: Notes, data, and documents you import, available for AI to read.

literature.title: Literature
literature.body: Papers added from the literature center, with bibliographic details for citation.

outputs.title: Task outputs
outputs.body: Reviews, reports, and code generated by tasks, linked to their source task.

workspace.title: Read files while you chat
workspace.body: Expand the workspace to full screen and the conversation task becomes a floating panel. Expand it when needed or collapse it to a bubble.

capabilities.title: Start with a research capability
capabilities.body: ScholarSeed helps you search for literature, write literature reviews, and generate research ideas. Choose a shortcut to start a task with your research question.

library.title: Your Literature Center
library.body: Search, organize and manage all your papers here, and add them to projects as needed.

import.title: Import literature
import.body: Import PDF, BibTeX, Zotero and more, with automatic metadata extraction.

categories.title: My collections
categories.body: Projects contain the papers used in each project. Create collections as needed to organize your literature.

ai.title: Task with your library
ai.body: Open ScholarSeed AI to search across papers, compare views and locate original evidence.

pdf.name: Reading papers
pdf.description: Figures, reading tools and text selection

figure.title: Let AI explain a figure
figure.body: Choose Figure explanation, then select a figure. AI explains its comparisons, how to read it and its conclusions.

tools.title: Reading assistant
tools.body: Use parallel translation, structured AI reading, literature notes and annotation review.

selection.title: Select text and ask
selection.body: Explain, translate or highlight a passage here. Add it to the task to ask follow-up questions.

ai.title: Start a task using this paper
ai.body: Open ScholarSeed AI with this paper as context. In a project, you can also compare it with other project papers.

sampleSelection.title: Select text to see its toolbar
sampleSelection.body: This is the real reading toolbar. Try selecting and copying in this sample; import your own paper to explain, translate, highlight, or add text to a task.
